spec.title: Average Travel Time by Traffic Density

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    traffic_density_level,
    ROUND(AVG(travel_time_minutes), 2) AS avg_travel_time
FROM traffic_weather_events
GROUP BY traffic_density_level
ORDER BY avg_travel_time DESC;

spec.title: Top 10 Routes by Average Travel Time

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    CONCAT(start_area, ' → ', end_area) AS route,
    COUNT(*) AS trips,
    ROUND(AVG(travel_time_minutes), 2) AS avg_travel_time,
    ROUND(AVG(average_speed_kmph), 2) AS avg_speed
FROM traffic_weather_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
GROUP BY start_area, end_area
ORDER BY avg_travel_time DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    distance_km,
    travel_time_minutes,
    traffic_density_level
FROM traffic_weather_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp);

SELECT
    stream_timestamp AS time,
    trip_id,
    start_area,
    end_area,
    traffic_density_level,
    average_speed_kmph,
    travel_time_minutes,
    live_temperature_c,
    live_precipitation_mm
FROM traffic_weather_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(stream_timestamp)
ORDER BY stream_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    traffic_density_level,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM traffic_weather_events
GROUP BY traffic_density_level
ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT
    $__timeGroup(stream_timestamp, '5m') AS time,
    ROUND(AVG(average_speed_kmph), 2) AS avg_speed
FROM traffic_weather_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(stream_timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
    historical_weather_condition,
    ROUND(AVG(travel_time_minutes), 2) AS avg_travel_time
FROM traffic_weather_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
GROUP BY historical_weather_condition
ORDER BY avg_travel_time DESC;

SELECT
    stream_timestamp AS time,
    ROUND(AVG(live_temperature_c), 2) AS temperature_c,
    ROUND(AVG(live_precipitation_mm), 2) AS precipitation_mm
FROM traffic_weather_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(stream_timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS weather_enriched
FROM traffic_weather_events
WHERE live_temperature_c IS NOT NULL
AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp);
